safe_content_feature_requests.title: Onboarding Tutorial Prompt System
safe_content_feature_requests.player_value: Helps first-time players understand initial movement and combat mechanics without guessing.
safe_content_feature_requests.rationale: First-session telemetry indicates players are dropped right into routes without guidance at step 0.
safe_content_feature_requests.desired_outcome: Display clear, friendly introductory guidance and UI callouts during the first few steps of the initial route.

safe_content_feature_requests.title: Route Discovery Ledger and Collection Milestones UI
safe_content_feature_requests.player_value: Gives collectors a clear view of missing items, unique collectibles per route, and completion milestone rewards.
safe_content_feature_requests.rationale: Currently, exploring various routes lacks a dedicated ledger to track specific regional collectibles like Ember Shards or Mooncaps.
safe_content_feature_requests.desired_outcome: Add an in-game ledger or collection tracker showing item counts and completion percentages per route.

safe_content_feature_requests.title: Thematic Cosmetic Pack Expansion
safe_content_feature_requests.player_value: Provides more long-term cosmetic goals for dedicated explorers who want to showcase route mastery.
safe_content_feature_requests.rationale: With 7 cosmetics currently available, collectors quickly acquire them and look for additional customization pieces themed after specific routes like Ember Forge or Moon Shrine.
safe_content_feature_requests.desired_outcome: Introduce a fresh batch of region-themed cosmetic items and hats to the marketplace.

safe_content_feature_requests.title: Enemy Bounty Coin Drops
safe_content_feature_requests.player_value: Provides active income during combat encounters rather than solely relying on flat route completion payouts.
safe_content_feature_requests.rationale: In the play trace, defeating Goblins yielded no direct coin feedback, making combat feel economically neutral despite its danger.
safe_content_feature_requests.desired_outcome: Configure minor coin yields (e.g., +2 to +5 coins) upon defeating standard route enemies to smooth out the currency curve.

safe_content_feature_requests.title: Marketplace Wishlist & Savings Tracker
safe_content_feature_requests.player_value: Helps players visualize their progress toward expensive items like the Waypoint Crown.
safe_content_feature_requests.rationale: Encountering the 'Not enough coins' message on the Waypoint Crown with only 21 coins left can feel abrupt without a progress indicator.
safe_content_feature_requests.desired_outcome: Add a UI wishlist indicator in the marketplace showing how many more runs are needed to afford locked high-tier items.

all_feature_requests.title: Keyboard Navigation Shortcuts for Marketplace & Inventory

all_feature_requests.title: Movement Command Input Buffering
all_feature_requests.player_value: Prevents accidental self-damage and jittery state transitions when repeatedly pressing movement keys against environmental blocks.
all_feature_requests.rationale: Edge-case telemetry shows players attempt to queue walk commands against active hazard collisions. Buffering or ignoring invalid movement commands improves handling feel.
all_feature_requests.desired_outcome: Movement inputs queued against obstacles are filtered or buffered safely until the obstacle is cleared.

observations.evidence: Play trace shows starting directly on 'moss' route without introductory context or tooltips explaining the walk/fight loop.
observations.recommendation: Introduce welcome tooltips at step 0 to explain basic movement and combat mechanics for first-time players.

observations.evidence: Completed Moss Trail easily with 3 enemy encounters and a straightforward sequence of walk steps.
observations.recommendation: Keep the Moss Trail difficulty gentle, but ensure a clearer route preview is available before selection.

observations.evidence: Completed Whispering Fen route and earned currency, but lacked any visible milestone trackers for unique collectibles like Mooncaps or Fen Pearls.
observations.recommendation: Introduce a route discovery ledger or collection milestone UI so collectors can track their finds across different themes.

observations.evidence: Successfully purchased the trail_cap cosmetic item with coins earned from the route.
observations.recommendation: Continue offering diverse cosmetic options and thematic hats to keep collectors motivated.

observations.evidence: In a Difficulty 3 route (Frostfang Pass), only 2 enemy encounters (Slime at step 2 and Kobold at step 11) occurred over 12 total steps.
observations.recommendation: Increase enemy spawn density and introduce mid-route elite encounters on difficulty 3+ routes to match the expected challenge level.

observations.evidence: Finished Frostfang Pass with 100/100 HP intact and +25 coins, completing the route without taking any damage or facing tactical pressure.
observations.recommendation: Adjust enemy attack patterns and introduce aggressive hazard-enemy synergies on high-tier routes to ensure risk aligns with reward.

observations.evidence: After completing 1 full route (Treasure Run) and collecting initial map coins, the player accumulated 146 total lifetime coins, enabling the purchase of two cosmetics (Trail Cap: 45, Moon Hood: 80) but leaving them short for the premium item (Waypoint Crown), resulting in 21 remaining coins.
observations.recommendation: Maintain a healthy gap between standard cosmetic purchases and elite luxury items, but consider adding small dynamic coin rewards for defeating route enemies to make active combat contribute more directly to currency flow.

observations.evidence: Marketplace purchase flow executed cleanly: buying 'trail_cap' (45 coins) left 101 coins, and subsequent purchase of 'moon_hood' (80 coins) successfully deducted funds and updated remaining balance to 21 coins.
observations.recommendation: Keep the immediate feedback and balance deduction logic, but add a wishlisting or saving progress bar toward unaffordable luxury items like the Waypoint Crown.

observations.evidence: Route completion reward (+25 coins) combined with step pickups (+5 coins) provided a clear single-run payout of 30 coins, demonstrating predictable reward pacing for a difficulty 2 route.
observations.recommendation: Ensure higher difficulty routes (difficulty 3+) scale coin rewards appropriately to prevent pacing bottlenecks when players target high-cost cosmetics.

observations.evidence: Backlog item 'High-Contrast UI Theme & Focus States' indicates marketplace navigation and UI elements lack clear keyboard focus rings.
observations.recommendation: Implement high-contrast focus rings and visible keyboard selection indicators across all menus and the marketplace.

observations.evidence: Market purchase feedback successfully displayed item name, price, and updated coin balance (126 coins).
observations.recommendation: Maintain clear transaction summary feedback like the current marketplace purchase confirmation message.

observations.evidence: Telemetry shows two consecutive 'obstacle_hit' events (damage: 8) when the player repeatedly sent walk commands against a step 2 obstacle before issuing a jump command.
observations.recommendation: Implement input buffering or command throttling for movement commands when blocked by obstacles to prevent spamming damage.

reports.session_summary: Evaluated the Ember Forge route as the QA Edge-Case Tester, focusing on movement validation, obstacle collisions, state transitions, and input buffering. Observed that repeating 'walk' commands against an obstacle results in redundant telemetry events and player damage without command throttling or input buffering.

observations.evidence: Telemetry shows two consecutive 'obstacle_hit' events (damage: 8) when the player repeatedly sent walk commands against a step 2 obstacle before issuing a jump command.
observations.recommendation: Implement input buffering or command throttling for movement commands when blocked by obstacles to prevent spamming damage.

bugs.title: Redundant Walk Collision Damage Spam
repro_steps: Walk forward to step 2 where an obstacle blocks movement.
bugs.expected: Player should either halt at the obstacle or receive a single collision notification without taking duplicate rapid damage ticks from redundant inputs.
bugs.observed: Player took damage multiple times (2x 8 damage) and generated redundant 'obstacle_hit' telemetry events before switching to jump.
